This fixture module stands in for a technique lesson: an explanation, a step-through of the
technique on a small worked example, and a practice list at the end.

<Figure caption="Breadth-first search on a small grid: the queue decides which cell is next.">
  <StepThrough frames="visuals/grid-bfs.frames.json" preset="walls" />
</Figure>

Reading the technique as fixed steps, without the animation, still explains what happens: the
grid tracks which cells have been visited, and the queue holds the cells still waiting their
turn, in the order they were added.
